component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.credHandled = false m.credReceived = false startSequence() end sub
sub startSequence() if m.credHandled <> true handleCred() else if m.credReceived = true print "start sequence complete" end if end sub
sub handleCred() m.store = createObject("roSGNode", "ChannelStore") m.store.observeFieldScoped("channelCred", "onChannelCred") m.store.command = "getChannelCred" print "channelCred pending after the command: "; (m.store.channelCred = invalid) m.credHandled = true end sub
sub onChannelCred(event as object) print "channelCred received: "; (event.getData() <> invalid) m.credReceived = true startSequence() end sub
